WHY RECONCILE READY

Two financial questions.
One connected view.

The product brings together the bookkeeping questions and commercial questions that Amazon sellers face.

“What made up this payout?”

Reconciliation needs clear categories, reviewed mappings and an understandable route into Xero. A bank total is only the starting point.

“What did these sales earn?”

Profitability needs the costs behind the products, including the expenses that aren’t supplied by the marketplace. Sales alone cannot answer that question.

Our focus

We’re starting with Amazon reconciliation and product profitability. Inventory visibility and planning are possible extensions, while the initial priority is making the financial picture understandable.
